notes: Union-find in a list: follow boss to each leader (pointing campers at their boss's boss on the way), join two different leaders, count down. Renaming a whole group at every friendship is right and needs a walk over the camp each time; never shortening the way lets the chains to a leader grow long; moving only one camper leaves the rest of the group behind.

traps: a friendship inside one group changes nothing
two groups joined through campers who are not their leaders
renaming a whole group at every friendship is over budget
long ways to a leader, walked in full every time, are over budget

rejects.name: renames a whole group, camper by camper, at every friendship
follows boss all the way to the leader every time, never shortening the way
moves only one of the two friends into the other group
